vehicles.edition: Vintage Vice City Pack: pre-order/launch bonus for either edition. Rockstar text (seen via search snippet) says digital pre-orders and purchases before 2026-11-20 qualify, plus physical while supplies last; Jalopnik says the offer ended end of 2026-11-19. Exact cutoff conflicts - confirm on support.rockstargames.com (blocked for our fetcher).
vehicles.acquisition: Claimed in-game via an Exploration task in the map index pointing to the Ocean View Hotel (Jalopnik; PC Gamer per search snippet). Garage: Shore Court personal garage. One search summary said Chapter 3 must be reached before claiming bonuses - not verified on a fetched page.
Comes with the Paradise Garage, Watson Bay (per Kotaku, Gematsu).

vehicles.edition: Base vehicle is Jason's car (not edition-locked as far as sources say). The 'Ganado Retro Build' modkit is Ultimate Edition only.
